name: Manage Tools
description: List, read, create, update, test or delete MyAgent tools. 'list' = all installed tools; 'get' = one tool's metadata and run script; 'save' = create or update (only the fields you pass change); 'test' = actually execute a tool with sample arguments; 'delete' = remove one.

id.description: Tool id = folder name, lowercase with underscores (e.g. 'word_count'). Required except for 'list'.

description.description: What the tool does — other models read this to decide when to call it. Required when creating.

parameters.description: JSON Schema of the tool's arguments: {"type": "object", "properties": {...}, "required": [...]}. Default: no arguments.

script.description: Full source of the executable 'run' script. Required when creating. Must start with a shebang; it reads one JSON object of arguments on stdin and prints its result on stdout.

timeout.description: Seconds before the tool subprocess is killed (default 30).

max_output.description: Output characters before the result is truncated (default 10000).

enabled.description: Disabled tools stay installed but hidden from agents (default true).

test_args.description: Arguments for action='test' — the JSON object the tool receives on stdin. Default {}.
